concept: A single beam from an oculus lights a black-stone chamber whose fine gold veins are washed out by the light. A cloud covers the oculus; in the dark the veins glow and reveal what was there all along: a door still ajar, a cup still warm, a coat still on a chair. The light returns and the veins stay faintly visible.
theme: Gratitude as recognition of what was given
quote: None of it was owed. All of it was given.
core_metaphor: The gold veins are already in the stone. Full light washes them out; darkness changes their visibility, not their existence.
emotional_arc: loss -> concession -> discovery -> recognition of the giver -> gift -> instruction
recurring_element: one circular black-stone chamber with an oculus beam, hairline antique-gold veins in the stone, and one threshold in the far wall: a dark door ajar with amber light behind it, a plain chair with a coat over its back, and a stone ledge with a cup
material: Black stone with hairline antique-gold (#C6A94F) veining, polished wet black stone floor, dark wood door and chair, charcoal wool coat, dark stoneware cup; one warm gold oculus beam
primary_prompt: Restrained photorealistic 9:16 sequence in one vast circular black-stone chamber with a round oculus. Fine antique-gold (#C6A94F) veins run through the stone, washed out by the single gold beam and glowing only when the light is gone. One threshold in the far wall: a dark door ajar with amber light behind it, a plain chair with a coat over its back, a cup on a stone ledge. Locked or slow camera, physically credible light. No faces, no portals, no fire, no lens flares, no floating objects.

hook.text: Everyone wants the light back. Fair.
hook.visual: Low view across the chamber: the oculus beam on the wet floor, hairline gold veins glinting faintly where it grazes. A cloud crosses and the beam narrows and dies.

build.text: But the dark shows you what was given.
build.visual: Near-black chamber. The same gold veins brighten in sequence across floor, columns and walls, spreading outward.

pivot.text: The chair. Someone held you up. The cup. Someone kept it warm. The door. Someone left it open.
pivot.visual: The threshold, lit by the glowing veins: the door ajar with amber light, the steaming cup on the ledge, the coat on the chair. One slow push-in per line.

resolution.text: None of it was owed. All of it was given.
resolution.visual: Wide: a backlit faceless silhouette stands near the glowing threshold, small against the chamber. Near-static.

mobius_close.visual: The cloud slides off the oculus, its edge lit gold; the beam returns and the veins stay faintly visible in the restored light.

caption:
Everyone wants the light back. Fair.

But the dark shows you what was given.

The chair. Someone held you up.
The cup. Someone kept it warm.
The door. Someone left it open.

None of it was owed. All of it was given.
